reels.title: He sat in the shade while others broke stone instead of him
reels.hook: He refused to work. Others worked for him.
reels.why: It has a clear image: he sits in the shade, and the guys in the hole are bleeding from the stones. The twist and the point about deeds instead of words provide a complete insight. It is funny and touching at the same time.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: Many times in life it is not important at all, words are not important, but deeds are important.

cards.text: He refused to work. Others worked for him.
Goran Ćurković · former addict, today an iconographer
Cenacolo Community in Međugorje: Goran refused to break stone in the quarry.
Summer in the quarry
for the first time in my life I saw that someone was doing something for me
words are not important, but deeds are important.
Goran Ćurković – testimony

reels.title: He opened the dining room door and saw the father he had betrayed
reels.hook: He opened the door and saw his father after 10 years
reels.why: The encounter with the father he hated for years is the strongest emotional moment of the episode. It has tension, shame, an embrace, and a sincere ending without false promises.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: And he, poor man, saw that it was hard for me, came up to me, hugged me and started to cry.

cards.text: He opened the door and saw his father after 10 years
Goran Ćurković · former addict, today an iconographer
After 9 years on the street, Goran is in the Cenacolo community and has no contact with his family.
he hugged me and started to cry. Then I hugged him
Goran Ćurković – testimony
For the first time I wanted to be honest with him, I didn't want to give him false hope.
cards.anchor: nisam mu htio davati lažnu nadu

reels.title: The friar promised him a director position. He got toilets
reels.hook: The friar promised him: you will be a director!
reels.why: A classic joke with a promise and a twist at the end. The hook is in the first sentence, and the point "director of toilets" closes the story.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: Goran, trust me, I will make a director out of you.

cards.text: The friar promised him: you will be a director!
Goran Ćurković · former addict, today an iconographer
Fra Slavko Barbarić from Međugorje is looking for a job for Goran after four years in the community.
Goran, trust me, I will make a director out of you.
Goran Ćurković – testimony
And I think to myself, my dear mother, director of toilets.

reels.title: The priest from Križevac was the one who prayed for her as a child
reels.hook: The same priest. Two encounters. 12 years apart.
reels.why: It has an incredible coincidence and a clear resolution: Katarina recognizes the priest from her childhood and a wedding in the church of the same name. The story has a beginning, a climax, and an end.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: That priest who was on Križevac, who lent her the Bible, was that one.

cards.text: The same priest. Two encounters. 12 years apart.
Goran Ćurković · husband of Katarina, father of five children
Katarina on Križevac prays whether she should marry Goran. A priest from a group of pilgrims lent her a Bible.
Childhood in the Czech Republic
She never saw that priest again

reels.title: She wanted to become a nun, and he laughed with three teeth
reels.hook: She wanted to go to a convent. He had three teeth.
reels.why: A humorous self-portrait and diagnoses listed one after another build a comical contrast. The ending with his stubborn certainty leaves the viewer wanting a continuation.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: Two gray and one black. What a handsome man, which woman wouldn't want me.

cards.text: She wanted to go to a convent. He had three teeth.
Goran Ćurković · former addict, today an iconographer
Goran cleans toilets in Međugorje and fell in love with a girl he saw only once.
younger than him
when I laughed, I had three teeth.
Two gray and one black. What a handsome man, which woman wouldn't want me.
Goran Ćurković – testimony

reels.title: The stepmother he hated for 9 years paid for Masses for him
reels.hook: He hated her. She prayed for him for years.
reels.why: The emotional turnaround toward the woman he hated turns into gratitude. It ends with a humorous point about a bullet in the head.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: She never grew tired, she never lost hope, she never stopped believing in me.

cards.text: He hated her. She prayed for him for years.
Goran Ćurković · father of five children, Međugorje
Goran talks about the "second mom", the woman his father married after his mother's death.
Mass every month for his conversion
She never grew tired, she never lost hope
with a bullet in the head
Look, no one can tell you that you have nothing in your head.
Goran Ćurković – testimony

reels.title: On cardboard next to a candle, he remembered the only prayer he knew
reels.hook: He hated God. Then he remembered one prayer.
reels.why: This is the turning point of his whole life: admitting his own guilt and a desperate prayer. Raw emotion and a clear image of a night on cardboard.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: Everything that happened in my life, I am the only main culprit.

cards.text: He hated God. Then he remembered one prayer.
Goran Ćurković · former addict, today an iconographer
February, a half-ruined little house, cardboard and a candle: Goran has been on the street for years.
Everything that happened in my life, I am the only main culprit.
I begin to cry and pray the Hail Mary.
My Lady… reach out your hand to me to change this wretched life.
Goran Ćurković – testimony

reels.title: A tramp got a free ticket to Međugorje and set off "on a trip"
reels.hook: A tramp got a bus ticket. Where to?
reels.why: A funny dialogue about the beginning of conversion: he thinks the woman is crazier than him, and he agrees because the trip is free. Short, concrete, and well-rounded.
reels.speaker: Goran Ćurković
reels.quote: I am a schizophrenic, but this one is a hundred times crazier than me, man.

cards.text: A tramp got a bus ticket. Where to?
